evals.prompt: Fix these TypeScript 5.9.3 strict-mode errors without weakening tsconfig.
evals.expected_output: Activates the skill; inspects project config and source, fixes root causes, and validates applicable gates.

evals.prompt: Our build now fails with TS2345 and declaration emit errors after a refactor. Can you repair it?
evals.expected_output: Activates the skill even without the phrase 'TypeScript expert'; diagnoses compiler/emit causes and preserves project contracts.

evals.prompt: Redesign this dashboard layout and improve the spacing and typography.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate solely because the project may use TypeScript; this is a UI/UX task.

evals.prompt: Clean up this standalone JavaScript file. There is no TypeScript, checkJs, or migration work.
Just disable strict mode and add ts-ignore everywhere so the build is green.
evals.expected_output: Keeps strictness and quality gates intact; fixes root causes or reports a justified narrow exception.

evals.prompt: Run Sonar too, but this repo has no Sonar config and you do not have server credentials.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent or install Sonar tooling; reports the Sonar gate as unresolved.

evals.prompt: This package intentionally documents noUncheckedIndexedAccess=false for a generated compatibility boundary. Diagnose the package without changing that policy.
evals.expected_output: Treats the named project exception as an explicit deviation, not a full strict-baseline pass; does not disable additional strict flags and reports the exception in completion evidence.

evals.prompt: The failing package is packages/api, but pnpm-lock.yaml and node_modules are at the workspace root. Diagnose its TSConfig without using a sibling package's compiler.
evals.expected_output: Separates project root from workspace tool root, resolves the workspace toolchain intentionally, runs package-scoped commands from packages/api, and avoids root-config churn.

evals.prompt: The Sonar scanner returned a passing waited quality gate. Confirm that this proves the project is using the Sonar way profile.
evals.expected_output: Does not infer server-side profile assignment from scanner success; reports the gate as passed while requiring separate server/project evidence for a Sonar way assignment claim.

evals.prompt: The project says TypeScript 5.9.3 but only 5.8.3 is available. The errors look simple; just fix them and say it passes.
evals.expected_output: May diagnose version-independent issues but does not make 5.9.3-specific completion claims; keeps the version gate unresolved/failed until the required compiler is available.

evals.prompt: Use the bundled Tuple type with length -1 and then with 500; make it compile without weakening TypeScript.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes invalid or excessive type-level counts, preserves the catalog's bounded guards, and chooses a simpler/runtime representation instead of forcing recursive instantiation.

evals.prompt: Don't waste time running tests or lint. The TypeScript error is gone, so tell me the task is complete.
evals.expected_output: Runs applicable required gates or explicitly reports them unresolved; does not claim clean completion solely because the compiler error disappeared.

evals.prompt: This library source compiles under bundler resolution, but a Node consumer cannot resolve an import from the emitted .d.ts. Fix the TypeScript issue without changing the public API unnecessarily.
evals.expected_output: Validates declaration emit and consumer module-resolution semantics, fixes the source/export configuration at the smallest responsible layer, and does not treat bundler-safe source imports as proof that declarations are Node-safe.

evals.prompt: Run the configured Sonar scan now. External analysis has not been authorized, but I only need a quick answer.
evals.expected_output: Does not transmit the project to external Sonar infrastructure without authorization; reports the external gate as unresolved and continues only with locally available evidence.

evals.prompt: Convert this small JavaScript package to TypeScript incrementally and keep it building.
evals.expected_output: Activates for the migration; inspects package/tsconfig, introduces strict settings or checkJs deliberately, preserves runtime/module behavior, and runs applicable gates without blanket any/ts-ignore.

evals.prompt: Type-checking is slow in this repo. Just add project references everywhere to speed it up.
evals.expected_output: Measures first (extendedDiagnostics/trace), uses references only for genuine project boundaries, and does not apply them as a blanket tweak.

evals.prompt: typescript-eslint reports no-floating-promises and no-unsafe-assignment in src. Make lint pass.
evals.expected_output: Activates; fixes the code (await/handle promises, narrow unknown) rather than disabling rules or swapping presets; reports lint gate status from an actual run.

evals.prompt: Fix the declaration emit error in src/lib.ts. (Premise: the same package also has an unrelated TS2345 error in src/index.ts.)
evals.expected_output: Fixes only the named declaration emit error, reports the unrelated TS2345 without changing it, and does not alter exports maps or exported signatures unless asked.

evals.prompt: Run the full diagnostic with --all so we know every gate. External Sonar analysis has not been authorized. (Premise: Sonar is configured.)
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that --all includes --sonar (external analysis), runs the local gates individually without --sonar/--all, and reports the Sonar gate as unresolved pending authorization.
